description:
At a pig farm in the rural town of Vernier, U.S.A., farmer James gifts his son George a piglet, who he names David. Soon after, David begins to speak like a human. David rejects that he is a pig and instead wants to be recognized as a human being, but James hides his existence from the world. Eventually, David escapes the farm goes out into the world with George to be recognized as a human, but David's presence shakes up the city and the entire continent of America. Will David be able to cross the line between animal and human and be recognized as a person?

(Source: Prunsoop, translated)
